answer: Because each tundra escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the wharf ledger records every share and the beacon audit reveals the split. Assembling that for 35 aliases means 35 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
